prompt: Target: 3-methyl-3-pentanol (3° alcohol with CH₃, Et, Et on the OH carbon). The shortest Grignard disconnection uses:

options.label: Acetone + 2 eq CH₃CH₂MgBr (double Grignard adds both ethyls)
Either (A) 3-pentanone + MeMgBr OR (B) 2-butanone + EtMgBr — both work in one step

explanation: 3-methyl-3-pentanol has CH₃ + Et + Et on the C-OH. You can disconnect either way: 3-pentanone (Et-CO-Et) + MeMgBr adds the methyl, OR 2-butanone (Me-CO-Et) + EtMgBr adds the ethyl. Both single-step. Option C (acetone + 2 eq EtMgBr) wouldn't work — you can't add 2 Grignards to a ketone (only 1), you'd need an ester.
